cases.mechanism_detail: Germline 6057-bp L1Ta1d inserted in APC exon 16 causing a frameshift/premature stop (p.(Asp1137delinsGluArgArg*)); detected by GRIDSS on hereditary cancer panel data and confirmed by Sanger/Nanopore sequencing. Proband with classical FAP at 14; mother and brother had colorectal polyposis (carrier status not stated).
cases.quote: The fifth case involved a six-kb long LINE1 element insertion in the APC gene, found in a patient diagnosed with classical familial adenomatous polyposis at age 14.

cases.mechanism_detail: Germline 280-bp AluYa5 inserted in BRCA2 exon 3 causing a frameshift/premature stop (p.(Lys53Alafs*9)); detected by GRIDSS on hereditary cancer panel data and confirmed by Sanger/Nanopore sequencing.
cases.quote: The BRCA2 variant detected in patient 11 corresponds to the well-known Portuguese founder Alu insertion c.156_157insAlu [13].

cases.mechanism_detail: Germline 284-bp AluYb8 inserted in BRCA2 exon 11 causing a frameshift/premature stop (p.(Val733Glyfs*32)); detected by GRIDSS on hereditary cancer panel data and confirmed by Sanger/Nanopore sequencing. Also detected (low VAF in data) in the proband's sister with breast cancer, absent in an affected cousin.
cases.quote: However, upon further inspection of the VCF files, the variant was found in the sister’s data but had failed to meet the GRIDSS quality threshold of 1500 (quality score = 918) and had been discarded.
